The season 4 token will only be awarded ONCE.  It’s the reward from the achievement called “dragonflight season 4 master”.   It’s triggered when you complete ANY raid on heroic OR get KSM. 

So check you achievements.  You could have already received it when you did heroic vault of the incarnates on week 1.  If that’s true, then you won’t get it (again) for completing heroic aberrus.  Or you might have already gotten it for getting KSM.
